newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Bilbao now setting sight on Brazil - paper.
newsitem.headline: Bilbao now setting sight on Brazil - paper.

text.p: Spain's Banco de Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) is setting its eyes on Brazil following its Argentine affiliate's announcement of a major acquisiion deal, a BBV official was quoted as saying Thursday.
"We have more than $1.0 billion to invest through the rest of 1997," BBV's representative Pedro Uriarte told La Nacion Newspaper.
"Now we go to Brazil to see what is going on there."
BBV is rapidly expanding in Latin America. Apart from Argentina, it has holdings in Mexico, Colombia, Venezuela, Puerto Rico, Panama and Peru.

On Tuesday, BBV-controlled Banco Frances in Argentina announced it will pay $466 million for a 71.8 percent stake in Banco de Credito Argentino, one of Argentina's top 10 retail banks. ((--Guillermo Haskel, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0650))
